reviewContext.userProblem: Text layout problems on architecture pages (clipped node label lines, overlapping edge labels, notes running into the element below) are only visible in an exported PNG. nodetto-cli lint accepts only BPMN and breadboard pages (apps/cli/src/commands.ts:289 filter, LINT_NO_PAGES at :94), so lint --page <architecture page> fails, and validate and edit pass while text is visibly broken.
requiredOutcomes: nodetto-cli lint doc.jsonl --page <architecture page> works: a clean page prints nothing and exits 0; crafted bad fixtures produce label-overflow, label-collision and note-overflow findings with element ids and measured vs available sizes; --format json uses the existing report shape (tll-01, tll-03).
Without --page, lint includes architecture pages alongside BPMN and breadboard pages; LINT_NO_PAGES becomes 'The document contains no BPMN, breadboard or architecture pages.' (tll-03).

nodetto-cli export --format svg|png|pdf of a whole architecture page prints the findings as 'warning: <ruleId> <elementId>: <message>' lines on stderr before the Wrote line; exported bytes and exit code are unchanged (tll-04).
Findings agree with the export renderer: a label that export wraps to fit is not reported; a clipped or spilling label line is reported; agreement is tested against renderPageSvg (tll-01).
Native CLI parity (mise run test-cli) passes with new text-layout cases that run, not skip; existing lint tests unchanged and passing; lint-ts and typecheck pass (tll-05, reconciliation).
Help text (help.ts overview, lint, export), docs/cli.md and design docs describe the three stable rule ids (tll-02, design docs).

constraints: Do not touch packages/io/src/bpmn (a parallel branch changes it); git diff --quiet a9728e6 on the renderer, bpmn, native and fixture paths must exit 0.
Findings are warnings only; lint exit codes unchanged (0 clean or warnings, 1 error findings, 2 usage/parse/config); BPMN and breadboard lint output and order unchanged.

Deterministic and Boa-friendly: no regex splitting in new lint code, labels laid out once, pair checks through an O(n log n) x sort-and-sweep prefilter; numbers formatted with String(Math.round(v*10)/10), never toFixed.

Test data are self-authored and generic (Payment gateway, HTTPS, gRPC, Audit log, Private network, Retry policy, Message queue) and name no external issue, customer, organisation, person, product or file.

Workers follow impl-plans/active/tll-00-overview.md 'Per-worker protocol' rules 1-9; bun tests with BUN_OPTIONS=--jsx-runtime=classic; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; no emojis; no tool attribution in commits.
designDecisionsAndRationale: The lint calls the export's own layout functions and element boxes (nodeLabelLayout, boxLabelLayout, connectorLabelLayout/Backdrop, wrapTextLines, createShapeContext, registry getBounds), so a finding means the export draws the text clipped, spilling or covered (design 'Overview').
The only shared-code change is an additive estimatedTextWidth export in text-layout.ts; no renderer file changes, so export output is byte-identical by construction (design 'Module').
Rules are scoped to architecture pages via TEXT_LAYOUT_LINT_PAGE_KINDS; rules depend on element types, so widening later is one line but would add warnings to existing runs (user-qa Q1).

label-collision reports a label pair once on the later edge (painted over the earlier); endpoint nodes are not excluded because shapes paint above connectors; a body enclosing all route points (zone) is skipped (design 'Rule label-collision').
note-overflow uses the note's own paddingY as required clearance so flush auto-height stacks are clean (design 'Rule note-overflow').
Export appends layout warnings to loaded.warnings only in the whole-page svg/png/pdf branch after the svg===null guard (design 'CLI: nodetto-cli export').
The native CLI runs the same TS bundle in Boa, so no Rust change; parity is proven by tll-05 (design 'Native CLI').
intentionalTradeoffs: Estimated glyph advance (0.55 em) is the measurement model; real CJK glyph clipping in resvg PNG is not detected (user-qa Q2).
Frame clipping is not modelled; an element fully clipped by a frame can still be reported.
Mixed BPMN/breadboard plus architecture documents now include architecture pages in the lint report (extra page headers and JSON pages[] entries); BPMN/breadboard findings and order are unchanged.
Rotated elements are not body items and rotated notes get no proximity probe; the clipped-note check still applies in local space.
Message ordering ties use localeCompare, relied on only for ASCII messages with distinct prefixes; tll-05 parity covers Boa vs Bun.
supportedEdgeCases: Label wrapped to fit (140x80 node) -> no finding; same label in 140x30 -> height finding with clipped-line count.
Box narrower than one glyph (24x60 node) -> width finding then height finding.
shape.geo label overflow uses 'spills outside the shape' / 'past the label padding' wording.
Two edges with coinciding label midpoints -> one finding on the later edge; edge label over an unrelated node -> finding naming 'node.generic <id>'.
Enclosing zone rectangle containing all route points -> no finding; rotated node under a label -> no finding.
Fixed-height note too short -> 'export drops <k> lines'; note text ending 3.8 above the next element -> 'Text ends 3.8 above'; element exactly paddingY below -> nothing.
Hidden elements, groups (children still linted), unlabelled edges and bpmn.* flows are skipped; findings deduplicated and sorted by element order, rule order, message.
300-node / 300-edge dense page lints deterministically and within the native per-launch budget.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real-font (CJK) glyph widths exceeding the estimate (user-qa Q2).
Freeform, flowchart, UML and other page kinds (user-qa Q1).
--element exports and non-svg/png/pdf export formats (user-qa Q3).
